{{Top|leg}}
The '''Corellian carousel''' was a maneuver developed by [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] because of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter's]] enormous blind spot, which proved a serious issue in flight. It consisted in putting the ship into a slow left-hand roll when maneuvering under fire or when making an approach in traffic. Because of the single high-mounted [[Rectenna/Legends|rectenna]] he had added to his YT-1300, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] pilot [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] needed to use the carousel very often, since the dish had an even larger blind spot than normal.
